For the Petitioner :- Mr. Lakhan Chandra Roy, Advocate For the Respondents :- Mr. Atanu Banerjee, G.A. Mr. Kaustav Panda, A.C. to G.A.
Order No.-03 Dated: 28.08.2018

The present writ petition has been filed for quashing the notice as contained in memo no. 892/6-5 Ma.Na.Pa. Madhpur dated 14.05.2018 (Annexure-3 to the writ petition) issued by the Executive Officer, Municipal Council, Madhupur-cum-Sub-Divisional Officer- cum-Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Madhpur - the respondent no. 4 whereby the petitioner has been directed to stop selling chickens (poultry business) in the allotted stall within 24 hours failing which the allotment of stall made in favour of the petitioner would be cancelled.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is carrying on the poultry business in shop no. 58 situated at Neta Jee Subhash Path, Madhpur (Raj Bari Road, Madhupur) since 1990 without complaint from any corner.

He has already obtained the licence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 from the Department of Health, Government of Jharkhand which has been renewed from time-to-time and therefore, the respondent-authority is not justified in issuing the notice dated 14.05.2018 directing the petitioner to stop the said business.

entities.text: Department of Health, Government of Jharkhand
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.

On perusal of the notice dated 14.05.2018, issued by the Executive Officer, Municipal Council,
Madhupur, it appears that on spot verification of the stall in question, the petitioner was found carrying on poultry business which, according to the authorities, is in contravention of the Jharkhand Municipal Act, 2011.
It has also been mentioned in the said notice that the petitioner has not been allotted the said stall for carrying on poultry business.

entities.text: Md. Nasir Ansari vs The Stand Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Since the petitioner has been issued the notice for stopping the poultry business in the stall in question, I think it appropriate to give liberty to the petitioner to file an application before the Executive Officer, Municipal Council, Madhupur- the respondent no. 4 by 5th September,
2018.

On receipt of the said application, the respondent no.4 shall consider the petitioner's application and pass appropriate order in accordance with law, preferably within a period of four weeks from the date of filing of the application.
Till the said application is disposed of by the respondent no. 4, the petitioner shall not be evicted from the stall in question.
The writ petition is disposed of with aforesaid liberty and direction.
(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Ritesh Md. Nasir Ansari vs The Stand Of Jharkhand on 28 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79945329/
